tagline.zh: 半透明磨砂玻璃面板:背景模糊 + 低透明度填充 + 1px 细亮描边,必须叠在丰富的彩色背景上才成立。
tagline.en: Frosted-glass panels: backdrop blur + translucent fill + a 1px hairline light border — only reads as glass over a rich, colorful backdrop.

origin.zh: 术语由 Michał Malewicz(Hype4)创造并于 2020 年 11 月命名(glassmorphism.com 站点自述);生产参照系是 Apple 全局导航与 macOS Big Sur 半透明侧栏(调研 03§1)。
origin.en: The term was coined and named by Michał Malewicz (Hype4) in November 2020 per glassmorphism.com's own account; Apple's global nav and the macOS Big Sur translucent sidebar serve as production reference points (research 03 §1).

effect.zh: backdrop-filter 背景模糊半径,玻璃『厚度感』的来源。默认 20px 取自 glassmorphism.com 生成器经典配方;生产实测:Apple 全局导航 20px、Framer 10px、Resend 25px(superdesign.dev)。
effect.en: backdrop-filter blur radius — the source of the glass 'thickness'. Default 20px is the glassmorphism.com generator's classic recipe; production: Apple global nav 20px, Framer 10px, Resend 25px (superdesign.dev).

effect.zh: 玻璃底色(含透明度)。默认 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15) 等价于生成器配方 rgba(255,255,255,0.15);白色 10–15% alpha 读作『霜面』(superdesign.dev)。
effect.en: Glass fill color incl. alpha. Default oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15) equals the generator recipe rgba(255,255,255,0.15); white 10–15% alpha reads as 'frost' (superdesign.dev).

effect.zh: 1px 描边颜色,承接环境光的细亮边。默认 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.3) 等价于生成器配方 rgba(255,255,255,0.3);玻璃感约一半来自这条亮边。
effect.en: 1px border color, the light-catching hairline. Default oklch(1 0 0 / 0.3) equals the generator recipe rgba(255,255,255,0.3); roughly half of the glass feel comes from this edge.

effect.zh: 圆角半径。默认 20px 为生成器配方;生产页面玻璃卡圆角集中在 16–20px(superdesign.dev)。
effect.en: Corner radius. Default 20px is the generator recipe; production glass cards cluster at 16–20px (superdesign.dev).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换 data-variant)。light=白霜玻璃(生成器配方);dark=深色玻璃变体,生产实测配方 rgba(17,25,40,0.55)(superdesign.dev),demo 会叠加深色薄层并反白文字。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-variant). light = white-frost glass (generator recipe); dark = dark glass variant with the production-measured rgba(17,25,40,0.55) recipe (superdesign.dev) — the demo stacks a dark veil and flips text to light.

note.zh: backdrop-filter:Chrome/Edge 76+(2019)、Firefox 103+(2022)、Safari 9+ 需 -webkit- 前缀,Safari 18(2024-09)起无前缀(调研 03§1)。
note.en: backdrop-filter: Chrome/Edge 76+ (2019), Firefox 103+ (2022), Safari 9+ requires the -webkit- prefix; unprefixed since Safari 18 (2024-09) (research 03 §1).

fallback.zh: 不支持 backdrop-filter 时,提高填充不透明度(或改用实色 surface)并保留描边与圆角,让文字回到实底上可读;Safari 9–17 记得写 -webkit-backdrop-filter。
fallback.en: Without backdrop-filter support, raise the fill opacity (or switch to a solid surface) while keeping the border and radius so text sits on a readable base; on Safari 9–17 also write -webkit-backdrop-filter.

use.zh: 彩色照片/渐变背景上的浮层卡片(登录卡、播放器、汇总卡)
use.en: Overlay cards over colorful photos or gradients (auth cards, players, summary cards)

use.zh: 悬浮导航与工具条——对照 Apple 全局导航 blur(20px)+saturate(180%)
use.en: Floating nav bars and toolbars — cf. Apple's global nav blur(20px)+saturate(180%)

use.zh: 模态/抽屉下面的层级垫层,让被遮内容保持可感知
use.en: Scrim layers under modals/drawers so covered content stays perceptible

use.zh: 图片上的字幕条与角标
use.en: Caption bars and badges on top of imagery

avoid.zh: 纯色/白色背景——玻璃在平色底上失效,只剩一层淡色矩形
avoid.en: Flat or white backgrounds — glass degenerates into a pale rectangle

avoid.zh: 小号正文与密集数据文字——填充稀释对比度,且底内容滚动时对比度持续变化
avoid.en: Small body text and dense data — the fill dilutes contrast, which also shifts as backdrop content scrolls

avoid.zh: 玻璃叠玻璃的多层嵌套——透出的层会互相发浑
avoid.en: Glass stacked on glass — layered translucency turns muddy

avoid.zh: 全屏内容层大面积使用——NN/g 已批评 Liquid Glass 全屏化伤害可读性(调研 03§2)
avoid.en: Full-screen content layers — NN/g criticized Liquid Glass' full-screen use for hurting readability (research 03 §2)

a11y.zh: 玻璃上的文字要按『透出的最亮与最暗背景』两种极端核对 4.5:1(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3);控件边界保持 3:1 非文本对比(SC 1.4.11);模糊层不得作为传达关键信息的唯一手段。深色变体(如 rgba(17,25,40,0.55))比白霜更容易守住对比度。
a11y.en: Check text on glass against the brightest and darkest backdrop extremes for 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3); keep component boundaries at 3:1 non-text contrast (SC 1.4.11); never let the blur layer be the sole carrier of key information. Dark fills (e.g. rgba(17,25,40,0.55)) hold contrast more reliably than white frost.

goal.zh: 用 backdrop-filter 复刻一块毛玻璃卡片:半透明填充、背景模糊、1px 半透明描边、大圆角与柔和投影,悬浮于彩色照片背景之上。
goal.en: Replicate a frosted-glass card with backdrop-filter: translucent fill, backdrop blur, a 1px translucent border, large radius and a soft shadow, floating over a colorful photo backdrop.

acceptance.zh: backdrop-filter: blur(Npx) 同时写 -webkit- 前缀兜底
acceptance.en: backdrop-filter: blur(Npx) with the -webkit- prefixed fallback in place

acceptance.zh: 填充、描边、圆角严格使用参数快照值,不要自行调整
acceptance.en: Fill, border and radius use the exact parameter snapshot values; do not adjust them

acceptance.zh: 背景必须是彩色照片或多层渐变——放在纯色底上玻璃会失效
acceptance.en: The backdrop must be a colorful photo or multi-stop gradient — glass breaks on flat color

acceptance.zh: 深色变体叠加 rgba(17,25,40,0.55) 一类深填充并反白文字
acceptance.en: The dark variant stacks a deep fill like rgba(17,25,40,0.55) and flips text to light

acceptance.zh: 提供 @supports 回退:不支持时提高填充不透明度保证可读
acceptance.en: Provide an @supports fallback: raise fill opacity for readability when unsupported
